purpose: Machine-readable curriculum coverage and assessment-quality manifest for the 24-week Learn-Apply-Check-Evidence pathway.

assessmentCoverage.qualityRule: All canonical weeks now use authored assessment questions with options plus correctIndex for deterministic scoring.

qualityGates: Every canonical week contains Learn, Apply, Check and Evidence.
Every week has at least one Check question.
Deterministic assessment banks use an authored correctIndex within the available options.
Compatibility-mode checks are explicitly identified and must not be mistaken for deterministic scoring.
Every canonical Evidence module has review criteria.
Evidence completion must remain gated by a passed Check.
Downstream signals must map evidence to competency, reflection and next action.
